fact: The IEC's data-free online voter registration portal lets voters check their voter registration status and confirm their voting station, per chief electoral officer Sy Mamabolo.

Minister Leon Schreiber said in a parliamentary reply that home affairs and the IEC share an electronic interface that verifies identity information submitted at voter registration and voting against the National Population Register.
ITWeb reports 29.2 million South Africans are on the voters' roll for the local government elections, which the IEC runs on a voters' roll application and voter management devices.
